W12

Help/technical request

/app/help
Roles: guest, student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: follow-onLegacy: P46

Offer task-focused product help and a reviewable technical issue form. Sending a request does not submit coursework, extend a deadline or prove a service action happened.

Entry and return
Global Help navigationSign-in recoveryContextual upload/quiz failureW11 tool help
Layout regions
Help landingSearchable task articles and institution sign-in help; Service status labelled sample or genuinely unavailable
Request formIssue location, description and optional redacted screenshot; Editable diagnostic checklist and never-included information
Request status panelAcknowledged reference, submitted facts, owner and chronological status; Return to original coursework status

Edit requestSubmit request
Permissions
  • Guests see generic help and redacted sign-in diagnostics only.
  • Academic pages, answers, grades and private messages are never automatic diagnostics.
  • Institution IT ownership remains assumed; no external message is actually sent by HTML.
Responsive
  • Article and form use one reading column on narrow web.
  • Attachment preview and review footer remain reachable above virtual keyboard.
Accessibility
  • Every diagnostic checkbox has its own label.
  • Error summary links to invalid fields; successful receipt heading receives focus.
Data
  • Help article fixture and explicit sample service status.
  • Request draft, selected diagnostics and simulated acknowledgement/reference.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A request receipt never changes assignment W22 or quiz W27 status.
  • Offline Submit cannot invent a request reference.
  • Removing all diagnostics leaves description-only review and submission usable.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
